split_note: THE PRICING SPLIT (owner ruling; RULEBOOK v2.1 law 4 G-MONO, amended 2026-07-28). The contract is re-issued because the ADOPTED CURVE'S DOMAIN changed, not its values: the national curve now covers picks 1-64 and every selection past 64 enters the pool, valued by position with order of selection carrying no value. There is no price for pick 70. Values over 1-64 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the superseded artifact; pool_value is that artifact's own value at index 65. No curve was refitted. A re-issue is correct here precisely because the contract exists to stop the curve moving SILENTLY - this move is ruled, declared, and recorded below.
